name: kg_find_node
description:
This tool can find nodes based on multitude of criterion.  You can search labels by semantic match.  You can search all nodes of given type.
You can perform temporal searches by specifying start/end_date.  If a node has no known start/end_date it is assumed to be valid for all time (back or forward).
You can specify number of max results in order to not be overwhelmed.  To reduce search space you can filter by demanding connection to known node.  You can request a random sample of a given size if you anticipate
full results to be too numerous.
All filters are optional.
Available filters:
start_date,
end_date,
node_types Must be one of: (entity, event, state, goal, property, concept) or empty for no filter,
node_id (to restrict to neighborhood of single id),
max_hops,
label (filters nodes by their labels),
taxonomy_path - most powerful filter to restrict to only nodes that have this classification.

Critical: If you ask this node to find you results IT WILL FIND THEM.  IF IT GIVES NO RESULTS.  THERE IS NO NODE MATCHING WHAT YOU ARE LOOKING FOR.

id of a node for filtering is UUID. If you give a UUID it will filter to the neighborhood of that node.
arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_find_node tool:

- text (required): The search text to find nodes
- threshold (required): Similarity threshold (0.0 to 1.0)
- k (required): Maximum number of nodes to return
- node_id (required): UUID of a single node to restrict search to its neighborhood (use empty string "" for no restriction)
- edges_k (required): Maximum number of edges to return per node
- node_types (required): List of node types to search for (use empty list [] for no filter)
- start_date (required): Start date filter (ISO format, use empty string "" for no filter)
- end_date (required): End date filter (ISO format, use empty string "" for no filter)
- max_hops (required): Maximum relationship hops from node_id to include (requires node_id to be set, use 0 for no limit)
- taxonomy_paths (optional): List of taxonomy paths to filter by (e.g., 'entity > person', 'state > educational_status'). Returns union of nodes from all specified paths. Use empty list [] for no filter.

Use empty strings or empty lists for parameters you don't want to filter by.
